note: This file is a MMSegmentation configuration file containing only dictionary-based model settings. It defines no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It is used as a base config to instantiate an ICNet model with a ResNet-50-D8 backbone for semantic segmentation.
summarize_config: summarize the ICNet ResNet-50-D8 segmentation model configuration settings
review_model_config: review the EncoderDecoder model config with ICNet backbone and FCNHead decode head
refactor_norm_cfg: refactor the SyncBN normalization config to use a different batch norm type
build_segmentation_model: build a semantic segmentation model using the ICNet ResNet-50-D8 config with 19 classes
test_auxiliary_heads: test the two auxiliary FCNHead branches with loss weight 0.4 in the ICNet config
